newsitem.title: INDIA: India Century Tex plunges on poor results.
newsitem.headline: India Century Tex plunges on poor results.

text.p: Shares of Century Textiles and Industries Ltd plunged for the second straight day on Wednesday after the diversified firm announced huge fall in profits, brokers said.
The flagship firm of India's B.K. Birla group said on Tuesday its net profits plummeted to 26.7 million rupees in the year ended March 31, 1997, from 1.9 billion a year ago.

A whopping 218.6 percent jump in interest and finance charges to 1.63 billion rupees from 510.7 million in 1995/96, poor market conditions in cement and paper, weak dry bulk freight rates in shipping and severe electricity shortages were the chief factors that hit profits, the firm said.
The share fell 225.75 rupees, or 11.1 percent, to 2,033.25 on the Bombay Stock Exchange in the first 15 minutes of trade after losing six percent on Tuesday.
